a) ⁧أنا مش عارف أعمل إيه.⁩ I don't know what to do.
b) ⁧إنت فين؟ أنا مستنيك من نص ساعة!⁩ Where are you? I've been waiting for you for half an hour!
c) ⁧معلش، القطر اتأخر.⁩ Sorry, the train has delayed. in Egyptian il-ʾaṭr,
d) ⁧بكرة الساعة كام؟⁩ What time tomorrow?

f) ⁧الحمد لله، النتيجة طلعت كويسة⁩ Thank God, the result was good.

Exercise 4. a) Levant: kifak, Shu, 3am ta3mel, halla2. · b) Gulf (or Iraq): shlonak, wayed. · c) Maghreb (Morocco): labas, daba, ghadi. · d) Egypt: ezayak, 3ayez, a2ablak (2 = ⁧ق⁩ ), bokra. · e) Levante (Lebanon): chou (ch french), baddak. · f) Gulf or Levant: 5555 for the laughter, 8 for ⁧ق⁩ ( 8alby). Exercise 5. a) Arabic: 3andy, el sa3a, w ba3Deeha; English: meeting, gym. I have a meeting at 3 And then I go to the gym. b) French: goods, cadeau; Arabic: ktir, ya3ni, el, kteer 7elo. Thank you very much, the gift is really beautiful! c) English: download, file; Arabic: 7a3mel, lel, w ab3Atholak. I'll download the file and send it to you. d) English: weekend, smile; Arabic: el, el gay, msh fady. I'm not free next weekend, sorry. 6. a) A new dish: salmon kushari. b) Endorsed by: 2 (good, but a little expensive); against: 1 (joking, ... is too much) and 3 (indignant: the original kushari has nothing like that); Prankful/neutral: 4 (invites you to try before judging) and 5 (approves comment 4, laughing). c) The 5: 5555 for the laugh. d) Remarks 2: ⁧أنا جربتها امبارح، بجد حلوة، بس السعر غالي شوية⁩ . Remarks 4: ⁧يا عم كل حاجة بتتغير، جرب الأول وبعدين احكم⁩ 😅 . e) Thanks everyone, remember that the traditional kushari stays on menu and that the new is for those who want to change. f) Example: The restaurant has announced a salmon kushari. Some users find it excessive or contrary to the traditional recipe, others have tried it and appreciate it, although they find it a bit expensive.
